root.title: Banner in markdown-editor
root.essence: Banner block: Markdown plugins and a visual editor for background, title, description, image and layout; 15 PRs, one commit each.

cats.name: Schema
cats.desc: Functions that describe ProseMirror nodes: schema, attributes, banner parts and extension options.

cats.name: Markdown
cats.desc: Functions that handle Markdown: markdown-it plugins, token parsing and writing directives back.

cats.name: Model
cats.desc: Functions that form the data model: value normalization, defaults and HTML/data attributes of the block.

cats.name: Commands
cats.desc: Functions that are ProseMirror commands changing the document: attributes, banner parts, undo steps.

cats.name: Cursor
cats.desc: Functions that handle the cursor, selection and keys: Backspace, Delete, Enter, arrows.

cats.name: Guards
cats.desc: Functions that guard the banner structure: one part of each type, extra parts unwrapped.

cats.name: Text
cats.desc: Functions that handle typing, pasting and dropping text: one line without marks.

cats.name: DOM
cats.desc: Functions that handle the editor DOM: NodeView, element attributes, clicks on the block.

cats.name: UI
cats.desc: Functions that are React components and popovers: settings windows, toolbars, palette, preview, focus and closing.

cats.name: Upload
cats.desc: Functions that handle images and files: link or file form, upload, cancel.

stacks.name: Base
stacks.essence: Shared settings windows, banner part commands, directives and image upload; background, title, description and image build on them.

prs.title: Shared settings windows and copying the banner as Markdown
prs.essence: The settings dialog, row and switch are shared by all windows; popovers close on Tab and ignore their own anchor; Copy copies the banner Markdown.

fns.name: SettingsDialog
fns.about: The settings window that opens next to a banner. It shows the window title and a close button and holds the fields of the part being set up. It closes on a click outside, on Tab past the last field and on the close button, so every settings window of the banner behaves the same and a new window does not repeat that work.
fns.without: It cannot go: the banner settings window is built on it. Without it each window would need its own title, close button and closing rules, and the windows would start to behave differently.

fns.name: SettingsRow
fns.why: Row: label and control linked via aria
fns.about: One line of a settings window: a caption and the control next to it, such as a size or an alignment picker. It links the caption to the control, so a screen reader says what the control changes. All rows of the settings windows look the same because they come from here.
fns.without: It can go, but every row would repeat the caption markup, and a missed link between a caption and its control would leave a screen reader user without a hint.

fns.name: SettingsSwitch
fns.about: A settings row with an on/off switch, for example to show or hide the banner image or a button. It moved from the banner settings to the shared settings parts. Now the window that shows the switch keeps its state and decides what a click does, so the same switch serves any block.
fns.without: It cannot go: the banner settings use it to turn the image, the buttons and other parts of the banner on and off.
